     encountered" pointing at the class declaration itself. This is not a
     parser limitation -- it is IRGen: this hermesc build (HBC v84) has no
     lowering at all for ClassDeclaration/ClassExpression nodes to bytecode.
     Same root cause as 32-class-basic/versions.txt.
